cancellation.rebooking: Customer is entitled to rebook on the next available flight within 24 hours at no charge.
cancellation.refund: Customer may choose a full refund.
cancellation.refund_processing: Refunds for airline-caused cancellations are processed within 7 business days.

over_5_hours.hotel_scope: Delayed hours only, not the entire night

fare_difference.rule: Customers choosing a higher-fare flight voluntarily must pay the fare difference.

loyalty.Gold: Priority rebooking / first access to next-available seats. No additional compensation beyond standard policy.
loyalty.Platinum: Priority rebooking / first access to next-available seats. No additional compensation beyond standard policy.

prohibited_actions: Approving compensation beyond the stated policy amounts
Handling compensation requests for missed flights
Handling threats of legal action or formal complaints
Processing refunds using a payment method different from the original
